## Strong endotacticity does not supply this missing fixed-volume contract

The ordered family is indeed strongly endotactic: it is weakly reversible with one linkage, as recorded in [Anderson–Cappelletti–Kim–Nguyen, Proposition 3.1](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1808.05328). It is also asiphonic: inflow produces A and B without any input, and source A+B can produce C without C. Their Theorem 6.2 concerns a scaled-volume Lyapunov inequality with the restriction V>exp(||x||_1). Its conclusion is not the uniform fixed-volume physical return/reward inequality required here. Their positive-recurrence Theorem 7.2 additionally requires a nonempty pure-species draining source family for EVERY species; the ordered raw list has none. ## Earned operation: decide after repayment, at one actual receiver

The previous first-source-switch resolvent pays the actual first switch, but its entire output law is outward on the ordered diagnostic. The new operation changes the stopping decision itself. On a large-A launch it lets a first source-gap-one event borrow B or C, follows its actual maximal-source repayment, and stops only after that repayment or a genuinely second-order error. The exact raw-word classification yields

    E[t^(M_out−M_in)]−1
       = (kappa_(k−1)/kappa_k)(1/t−1)/A + O(A^−2).

The coefficient is computed from the complete finite raw-source policy in check_global_construction.py. Individual first-switch outputs need not decrease. The phase-1 and phase-2 borrowed inventories are repaid to the identical original A-axis state; source aliases at later phases have identical physical increments; the terminal overrun returns with one fewer A.
